Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Maintainer ruling 6464202770 on #27119 (batch #421 item 2, Q2 = X, maintainer 「其他同意」 2026-10-28): no surface guesses a currency. The card's own `Ruling-ref: 6464202770` and Task list are binding: the Studio dataset inspector stops writing `currency: 'USD'` when no currency is picked; a measure then inherits through the existing chain (explicit measure currency → the source field's fixed currency → the tenant default). No further ruling.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure on `origin/main` `b8615afa`; disproof welcome)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx` ≈L211–215: `buildMeasureFormat('currency', …)` returns `currency: currency || 'USD'`. With an empty pick it returns `{ format, currency: undefined }`, and the saved measure carries no `currency` key at all (check the emit path drops an `undefined` key rather than writing `currency: undefined` or `''`).
- The currency picker's empty state reads as "inherit" (an i18n string if a new label is needed, en + zh, plus what the i18n gates demand). Find whether the picker today pre-selects USD; if it does, the default becomes the empty/inherit state.
- ⛔ A stored `currency: 'USD'` the inspector wrote earlier stays as authored (it is explicit on the wire): no migration, no rewrite on load. The PR body says so.
- Scan the same inspector (and its measure-format helpers) for any other `'USD'` default on the write path; report each, fix only those that write a guessed currency on save.

### Scope

File surface: `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx` (and a measure-format helper if the guess lives there), i18n keys if any, tests. Tests: empty picker ⇒ saved measure has no `currency` key; a picked `CNY` ⇒ `currency: 'CNY'` (control); a loaded measure with `currency: 'USD'` round-trips unchanged. Ablation: restore `|| 'USD'` ⇒ the first test goes red. Stay under 500 changed lines.

Serial: open PR #27163 (#27054) edits this file's imports and filter section (not `buildMeasureFormat`). Merge `origin/main` before your gates; if #27163 lands first, re-run the inspector tests.

### Tier

Quote `dispatch-gates --tier` on your surface. Expected none. `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `low`. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. `@object-ui/app-shell` is private: `skip-changeset` unless you change a published package (then a patch changeset for it).

Landed · seat `domain:ui#1` · `session_01JQwxbZeBv2y91towxasSUT` · 2026-10-28T11:45Z

PR #27208 merged as `48bffe389e` (seat record: PR comment 6467000658, addendum 6467637918). The Studio dataset inspector no longer stores a guessed `currency: 'USD'`, and its picker no longer pre-selects USD. Over a `currency` field the picker opens on "Inherit — field or organization default", and the saved measure carries no `currency` key, so it resolves the field's fixed currency and then the tenant default (ruling 6464202770 on #27119). Over any other field the picker asks for a code. A stored code, `'USD'` included, is left as authored. The road to merge took one queue ejection, the foreseen conflict with #27163. `pm:dispatched` is removed with the close.
